title: Fireplace drawings.
officialText:
The construction documents shall describe in sufficient detail the location, size and construction
of masonry fireplaces. The thickness and characteristics of materials and the clearances from walls, partitions and ceilings shall
be clearly indicated. The masonry fireplace shall comply with the provisions of Section 2111.
SECTION BC 2102
DEFINITIONS AND NOTATIONS
